title: DermViT
description: Local 7-class HAM10000 dermoscopic skin lesion classification with a quantized Vision Transformer (ViT-Base-Patch16-224) and optional 5x5 occlusion sensitivity mapping. Research and educational use only; not a medical device.

classify.title: Classify dermoscopic lesion
classify.description: Classify a dermoscopic JPEG or PNG image across the 7 HAM10000 lesion classes locally with ONNX Runtime Web, with optional Shades of Gray color constancy and 5x5 occlusion sensitivity mapping.

image.description: One dermoscopic lesion image (JPEG or PNG).

backend.description: ONNX Runtime Web backend; auto prefers WebGPU when available and falls back to WebAssembly (CPU).

colorConstancy.description: Apply Shades of Gray (Minkowski p=6) color constancy normalization before resizing to 224x224.

computeSaliency.description: Compute a 5x5 occlusion sensitivity heatmap for the top predicted class (25 forward passes).
